pages.description: This printable coloring page depicts Genshin Impact Paimon walking slowly across a snowy field, wearing mittens, boots, and a fringed scarf beneath her simple floating ring. Her hair is tied at one side with a bow as round snowflakes fall. Open snowbanks, bare trees, and broad winter clothing sections make up the coloring sheet.
